answer: The tollbooth is Lintel setter coping stone mark carved into the paving yard ledger. The toll is each coping stone is a coping stone set beside the masons mark, so a mason must set, payable once per identity, never in bulk. A farm that wants 554 seats must buy 554 tickets at 92 POA each, a 50968 POA outlay for one epoch. Check the violet with the issuer, check the saffron with the ledger, and check the juniper with the archive: three calls, three answers, no trust needed. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
